description: Western Province - Appointed Hon. Edirisingha Arachchige Isura Dewapriya Dharmasena Perera as the Chief Minister w.e.f. 08.09.2015 and as the Minister of Finance & Planning, etc., w.e.f. 14.09.2015 and Hon. Ranjith Somawansa Kalawila Withanage as the Minister of Education, etc., Hon. Andarage Don Gamini Thilakasiri as the Minister of Agriculture, etc., Hon. Kejitan Lalith Wanigarathna as the Minister of Fisheries, etc., and Hon. Gayan Nishantha Sriwarnasinghe as the Minister of Health, etc., w.e.f. 14.09.2015 and Mrs. J. M. C. Jayanthi Wijethunga as the Secretary to the Ministry of Finance & Planning, etc., and 05 other Secretaries to the Ministries w.e.f. 14.09.2015
